name: codex-automation-tools
description: Local and remote Codex automation context bootstrapping helpers.

interface.shortDescription: Create automations with reusable local or remote context.
interface.longDescription: Codex Automation Tools adds skills and helper scripts for bootstrapping personal automation workspaces with script-local context, remote host registries, remote runtime manifests, memory, history, artifacts, and safe secret-reference policies.
defaultPrompt: Create this automation with reusable context.
Register a remote automation host from SSH config.
Create this as a [remote] automation on a host.
Bootstrap context for an existing automation.
